questions.stem: After a sprint, a runner continues to breathe heavily for several minutes. What is happening in the body during this time?

options.text: Extra oxygen is being used to convert lactic acid back to glucose in the liver
The body is storing oxygen for the next sprint
The lungs are repairing damage from exercise
The muscles are continuing to exercise without the runner knowing

questions.explanation: Heavy breathing after exercise provides extra oxygen to repay the oxygen debt. This oxygen is used in the liver to convert lactic acid back to glucose, and to restore oxygen reserves in the muscles and blood.
